text:
Which procedure may be used to demagnetise a steel bar?
A
cooling it in a freezer for several hours
B
earthing it with a copper wire for several seconds
C
removing it slowly from a coil carrying an alternating current (a.c.)
D
rubbing it in one direction with a woollen cloth

options.label: A
options.text: cooling it in a freezer for several hours

options.label: B
options.text: earthing it with a copper wire for several seconds

options.label: C
options.text: removing it slowly from a coil carrying an alternating current (a.c.)

options.label: D
options.text: rubbing it in one direction with a woollen cloth
